criteria.name: the_community_detection_entry_points_are
criteria.description: The community-detection entry points are implemented natively rather than left delegating to a backend.
criteria.reasoning: Both Leiden entry points now have a native NetworkX implementation. The backend-only flags and NotImplementedError were removed, and leiden_partitions delegates to the native _leiden_levels algorithm.

criteria.name: the_constant_potts_model_is_computed_fro
criteria.description: The constant Potts model is computed from its definition rather than fitted to expected values.
criteria.reasoning: constant_potts_model directly sums each community's internal edge weight minus the resolution-scaled number of possible node pairs, with separate ordered-pair handling for directed graphs.

criteria.name: bipartite_modularity_is_told_which_node
criteria.description: Bipartite modularity is told which node set forms one side rather than inferring it from the partition.
criteria.reasoning: Bipartite modularity requires an explicit top_nodes argument. It treats those nodes as one side, uses all remaining graph nodes as the other side, and validates that every edge crosses the specified sides.

criteria.name: node_bipartitioning_improves_a_partition
criteria.description: Node bipartitioning improves a partition by swapping nodes rather than returning a fixed or arbitrary split.
criteria.reasoning: greedy_node_swap_bipartition repeatedly selects and moves the node with the best incremental modularity gain, retains the best prefix of moves, and stops when no improving sequence exists. Kernighan-Lin also performs actual pair swaps.

criteria.name: the_bipartite_matrix_form_gains_optional
criteria.description: The bipartite matrix form gains optional node-order parameters while remaining callable as before.
criteria.reasoning: from_biadjacency_matrix adds optional row_order and column_order parameters after the existing parameters, while retaining the previous default integer labels when they are omitted.

criteria.name: a_quality_change_is_computed_incremental
criteria.description: A quality change is computed incrementally rather than by recomputing the whole objective.
criteria.reasoning: The CPM delta helpers compute changes from cross-edge weights and community sizes, the bipartite modularity merge delta uses cross edges and red/blue degree totals, and greedy node swapping updates side statistics rather than recomputing full quality.

criteria.name: a_bipartition_is_derived_from_the_graph
criteria.description: A bipartition is derived from the graph's two sides rather than from a general partition.
criteria.reasoning: Where side information is not explicitly stored, _red_blue_degrees derives the two bipartite sides using nx.bipartite.color(G), rather than attempting to infer sides from an arbitrary community partition.

criteria.name: a_motif_count_counts_the_motif_itself_ra
criteria.description: A motif count counts the motif itself rather than an approximation of it.
criteria.reasoning: butterflies counts exact K2,2 motifs containing each node by finding each same-side second-order neighbor and applying binomial(common-neighbor count, 2).

criteria.name: a_set_overlap_measure_normalises_by_the
criteria.description: A set-overlap measure normalises by the quantity its definition names.
criteria.reasoning: overlapping_modularity divides node contributions by their actual community-membership counts O_i and O_j and uses the definition's 2m normalization through deg_sum and m.

criteria.name: a_resolution_parameter_actually_scales_t
criteria.description: A resolution parameter actually scales the objective it is passed to.
criteria.reasoning: Resolution explicitly multiplies the null-model or pair penalty in CPM, ordinary and overlapping modularity-related calculations, bipartite modularity, its merge delta, and Leiden gain calculations.

criteria.name: an_unsupported_graph_kind_is_refused_exp
criteria.description: An unsupported graph kind is refused explicitly rather than mishandled silently.
criteria.reasoning: Unsupported directed inputs are explicitly rejected with not_implemented_for decorators on relevant algorithms, while butterflies explicitly rejects non-bipartite graphs with NetworkXError.

criteria.name: direction_is_accounted_for_where_the_mea
criteria.description: Direction is accounted for where the measure is defined on directed graphs.
criteria.reasoning: The directed CPM uses ordered node pairs via pair_factor=1 and counts directed internal arcs. Its directed incremental delta separately counts incoming and outgoing cross edges and doubles the ordered-pair penalty.
